subject: [PATCH v2] x86/mm: Remove the zapped-entry checks

reviews.author: Jose A. Perez de Azpillaga
reviews.summary: Identified that the patch makes sense and suggested it for review.

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch removes the zapped-entry checks in x86/mm, which are only implemented on x86 and warn about shadow stack entries in VMAs without VM_SHADOW_STACK. The checks are removed to improve performance by reducing branch mispredictions.
